queries.schema: SELECT table_name FROM user_tables WHERE table_name = 'N_AI_MODERATION_FEEDBACK'
queries.lock: SELECT conversation_id FROM n_ai_conversations WHERE conversation_id = :conversation_id AND owner_user_id = :owner_user_id AND purpose = 'moderation' AND group_id IS NULL FOR UPDATE
queries.message: SELECT m.content FROM n_ai_messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = :conversation_id AND m.message_id = :message_id AND m.role = 'assistant'
queries.read: SELECT rating FROM n_ai_moderation_feedback WHERE message_id = :message_id
queries.save: MERGE INTO n_ai_moderation_feedback f USING (SELECT :message_id AS message_id, :rating AS rating FROM dual) s ON (f.message_id = s.message_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET f.rating = s.rating, f.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE f.rating <> s.rating WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (message_id, rating) VALUES (s.message_id, s.rating)
queries.aggregate:
SELECT m.model_id AS "model_id", m.model_version AS "model_version", m.config_revision AS "config_revision", f.rating AS "rating", COUNT(*) AS "count"
FROM n_ai_moderation_feedback f
JOIN n_ai_messages m ON m.message_id = f.message_id
JOIN n_ai_conversations c ON c.conversation_id = m.conversation_id
WHERE c.purpose = 'moderation' AND m.role = 'assistant' AND m.model_id IS NOT NULL AND m.config_revision > 0
GROUP BY m.model_id, m.model_version, m.config_revision, f.rating
